name: GJH Can — South Africa Abalone
summary: A 425g canned south africa abalone with a label unrolled from the official South Africa SKU packshots.
description: Metre-scale tinplate can with thin rolled gold seams, a recessed lid with pressed rings, opening score, ring-pull and rivet, a recessed base, and a 360-degree label unrolled from the official GJH eShop packshots (front, food-photo and nutrition panels).
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Deterministic Blender Python geometry (tinplate can, seams, lid, ring-pull). Label texture is unrolled from the owner's source-verified official packshots; no logo or text was redrawn or generated.
accuracy_notes: Diameter is a nominal 73.5 mm and height follows the packshot aspect ratio; a retailer listing gives 7.5 x 11 x 7.5 without units, so real dimensions are unverified. Label panel order and spacing are estimated (see label_layout). Packshot limb zones are not used. Shading baked into the photographs is partly divided out.

attribution.credit: Label artwork unrolled from GJH eShop official packshots recorded in Webpage-Design-Gallery assets/companies/gjh/official (manifest.json). Can geometry is original.

rights: Packaging artwork belongs to its respective owners (GJH / New Moon). Used in the owner's project on the owner's confirmation; no independent licence document was supplied. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

label_layout.method: Each packshot is treated as a cylinder panel (angle = asin of the normalised column). Seam positions and panel spacing are chosen to minimise colour and artwork mismatch at the seams, constrained to close the circle.
label_layout.status: Panel order and spacing are estimates, not verified against a physical can or a die-line.
label_layout.gap_note: No gap: the three official panels cover the full circumference.
